column3: Manami Route ・ Just Like a Galge
You ate the whole thing.  I'm really happy...!
But... you didn't force yourself, did you?
Why would I? I'm fine!
I mean, there were two of them...
You really, rea-lly forced yourself... right?
I said I didn't!
Ha-hawaa... R-Really?
Manami, don't you know about the stomach of a growing young man?
H-Hmmm... I wonder... It's true that Rock eats a lot too, but...
Right? I'm telling you, it's totally normal!
R-really? Even for Kyou-chan?
Totally! That's why I have LOTS of room to spare, see?
I see～! That's good...
Eh... ok, maybe a little bit, I guess...
Uhh... S-Sorry～
Nah, don't be. Just a teeny, tiny bit, so no worries!
Really...?
Well, I mean it happened so suddenly.
That's true. I'll have to be more careful...
Nah, it's fine if you make them that way. So don't get all bent out of shape.
Really? Okay, so from now on, I'll make things that are easier to eat!
E-Easier to eat?!
For example～, soba or udon or soumen!
Wa-Wait!
You want me to eat them cold?
Ah, yes, that's true. Hmmm... And if I brought a heater, I'd probably get in trouble...
R-Right...
What should I do...? I have to think up a lot of different foods to make～
Ma-Manami... That's not for a bento!
I'll give it my all! I want Kyou-chan to be happy! Right!
What should I do...? I have to think up a lot of different foods to make～
Ah! Maybe sometimes I could also make cold tofu!
C-Cold tofu?
Yup. I need to make sure it's healthy and good for you, so I'll also put in lots of green onions!
Cold tofu in a bento...?
Ahh, don't you worry, there's also a main dish so it's fine!
That's not the point...
It's... not?
I mean, just imagining it was enough to fill me up.
I like slightly richer tastes...
Is that so...? I see...
Then, yes. Maybe I'll try some grilled eels!
Wow, that's... an impressive choice...
Oh right Kyou-chan... About that bento earlier...
Hmm? What, you're not going to tell me there's still one more right?
That's not it!
Are you an idiot?!!
The bento you ate earlier... How was it?
Was it... not good?
So that's what this was all about...
Hmmm...
Simply saying "Delicious" might not be the right choice of words.
It was her first time, and she really worked hard to make it for me. Maybe it'd be better to say something like on those Cooking TV shows.
Also, if I say what I think straight out... Hmm... What should I do?
It really wasn't good then...
Hu-Huuuh!? I haven't even answered yet!!
There's no way it wasn't! Of course it was delicious!
Eh!?  Really?
Yup! I even refused to give any to Akagi because it was so good!
So, is that how you're grading it?
It was so good I could eat it all in one bite! Thank you!
Oh... I'm glad～
Yeah, I have to say "It was great" and "Thank you" to her face, or else she won't get it.
Say, Kyou-chan...
Yeah?
Can... Can I ask you something?
Maybe... You're forcing yourself to say this? Maybe... My bento really was a bother to you...?
Ehh, what the heck, Manami...? What's that look for?
It's just... err... hmm...
Things were going so well until now! Ughh, I just don't understand girls! So Kirino wasn't so different after all! No... let's not jump to conclusions here...
So, that's really it, isn't it... *sniff* *sob*
What the heck?  No, no, that's not it at all.
Really...?
Of course!  Isn't it obvious?  Don't make me have to repeat myself again, you hear?
Oh... I'm glad...
